lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance circular spots are arranged in roughly vertical columns posterior to the gill slits. At least five columns are visible, each containing between three and five primary nodes with regular vertical spacing.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of higher pixel intensity intersect the primary spot columns, forming a rectilinear grid pattern across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three prominent horizontal ridges are visible, exhibiting a sharp transition from high-intensity highlights on the upper edge to low-intensity shadows on the lower edge, running parallel to the longitudinal axis.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Presence of three distinct markings highlighted by overlaid arrows: two circular indentations/scars near the posterior gill margin and one elongated curved scar on the central lateral flank.
other_distinctive_markers: Significant variation in spot size and density, transitioning from dense micro-spots on the cephalic region and pectoral fin to larger, sparser macro-spots on the lateral body.
